In fact I think we are missing a bit of architecture needs to make this happen but you could give a try at:
- adding a refine() to https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/146b8e1c3d62ca6a462346f9c8a68d05cbc96f69/packages/react-instantsearch/src/connectors/connectConfigure.js that would add a configure: {} part to the state with all the query parameters used on the Configure (and merging with other configure widgets usages)
- add a cleanup that would clean only the relevant query parameters passed down for this particular widget https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/146b8e1c3d62ca6a462346f9c8a68d05cbc96f69/packages/react-instantsearch/src/connectors/connectConfigure.js
- call refine() as soon as possible in the Configure widget https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/146b8e1c3d62ca6a462346f9c8a68d05cbc96f69/packages/react-instantsearch/src/components/Configure.js. This is the tricky part as no widget today are doing this so dunno how it will go

Ultimately we may need a way to be able to enhance the search state as soon as possible without having to call refine manually immediately because that could lead to weird behaviors.
